row.name: Modern farmhouse in Marin
row.raw_input: 1,800 sf custom modern farmhouse in Marin County, CA. 3 bed, 2 bath. Slab-on-grade foundation. Mid-grade finishes. New construction on existing lot. Want to start late summer 2026.
row.ai_summary:
Alright, here's how I'd read it: 2,800 sf custom build in Marin lands in the $900k–$1.2M range delivered. Marin County permitting is strict and slow — Title 24 envelope compliance plus seismic detailing (CRC R403.1 on slab + R301.2 wind/seismic) push the structural and envelope cost. Long-lead items: custom millwork (8–10 weeks), Title 24-compliant glazing (6–8 weeks), and the seismic engineering review before permit (often 4–6 weeks). Slab-on-grade simplifies sub-floor but you'll pay extra for the engineered fill if the lot has any drainage concerns. Foundation rebar schedule for Marin seismic zone is denser than coastal SD — your concrete sub needs to know what they're bidding.

Jurisdiction: Marin County, CA
